text:
maria: RFC follow-up: propose a concrete agent/operator state machine for air-gapped activation so liveness probes don't cause premature pod restarts during long seed or HSM operations. Need decisions on fields, gating rules, and admin overrides.
aj: We hit this on a customer site yesterday. Seed copy from USB took ~4m, kubelet killed the sidecar after 30s. App never recovered.
kevin: TL;DR: split "pod healthy" (kube liveness) from "activation-ready" (operator-driven). Liveness should only check a fast local signal. Activation should rely on a mutually authenticated verified state.
ben: Concrete proposal: agent exposes a tiny local marker file/metric when process is up and cache is intact (state: up). Separately agent runs verifier in background and writes a versioned token to /var/lib/redwood/agent_state/verified-<image-version>. When token present + consensus checks, operator flips CRD status -> verified.
sre: We must avoid flapping: require 3 consecutive successful verifications within 90s, with exponential backoff on failures. Use a sliding-window counter (atomic) persisted to disk.
maria: Operator CRD change suggestions (status only):
- status.activationState = one of [PendingBootstrap, Bootstrapped, Verifying, Verified, Degraded]
- status.verifierAttempts = integer
- status.verifierLastSuccessTs = RFC3339 timestamp
- status.verifierToken = short hash of verified token (not raw token)
- status.pendingReason = human string for UI/cli
These are read by console and redwoodctl.
kevin: Probe snippet (very small):
```bash
# liveness probe: check local bootstrap marker (very fast)
if [ -f /var/lib/redwood/agent_state/bootstrap-ready ]; then exit 0; else exit 1; fi
```
aj: Important: scrub bootstrap-ready on image upgrades. Agent should write a versioned token at boot and delete old tokens on clean startup so stale files don't trick kube.
ben: For HSM/on-prem KMS: allow an offline-attest mode. Agent generates an HSM quote and stores attest file alongside bundle. Operator can later reconcile attest when cluster has manual slewing to a verifier appliance. This decouples HSM latency from pod liveness.
sre: Metrics & observability: add prometheus metrics: redwood_agent_verifier_attempts_total, redwood_agent_verifier_successes_total, redwood_agent_state{state=\"up\"|\"verifying\"|\"verified\"|\"degraded\"}. Operator should emit alerts when many activations stuck in PendingBootstrap > X mins.
maria: Admin UX: operator should expose annotation/field to allow manual override (spec.activation.manualOverride=true) for emergency activation (writes an audit log entry and requires privileged RBAC). Also expose redwoodctl command: `redwoodctl activation show <cluster>` to surface activationState and verifier history.
kevin: Edge case: partial verifier availability (brief window). Do not flip to verified on a single success. Require N-of-M within T seconds. If flapping detected, operator enters Verifying with exponential backoff and a "cooldown" period before retry.
aj: Implementation notes:
- Agent: write /var/lib/redwood/agent_state/{bootstrap-ready,verifying,verified-<ver>} as small files; expose /metrics and /status endpoints for operator polling.
- Operator: watch files via node agent or read via sidecar API; update CRD status fields. Activation controller gates rollout on status.activationState==Verified. Provide fallback policies: allow partial-activation to a lower-trust tier.
ben: Minimal CRD status patch example (status only):
```json
{"status": {"activationState": "Verifying", "verifierAttempts": 2, "pendingReason": "waiting for 3/3 verifier confirmations"}}
```
maria: Note: do NOT put raw tokens in CRD. Always store a short hash and rotate it per image/build. Agent should sign the token with local key so operator can verify authenticity later.
sre: Ops checklist for RFC: include rollout plan:
- default kube liveness -> bootstrap-ready check (fast)
- operator requires verified for activation
- enable metrics and alerting thresholds
- admins get manualOverride flow guarded by RBAC + audit logs
- provide migration job to scrub stale bootstrap files across clusters during upgrade
We should also add a small e2e test that simulates slow seed pulls and verifies operator does not restart pods prematurely.
aj: I'll add sample e2e harness steps. Who will draft the CRD additions? @ben?
ben: I can draft CRD status schema and the operator gate logic. Will post a PR with tests.
maria: Let's aim to land the RFC patch for these changes (docs + CRD schema + probe snippets + metrics) by next Tue. Thanks. @kevin please add the liveness snippet to runtime package. Ops-bot: noted and will create follow-up ticket.
